hints.title: Suffix Flip Parity
hints.text: Flipping an entire suffix changes the state of all subsequent elements.

hints.title: Tracking Inversions
hints.text: Maintain cur_flips representing the total number of suffix flips performed so far.

hints.title: Parity Evaluation
hints.text: An element nums[i] has current value nums[i] ^ (cur_flips % 2). If this value is 0, trigger a suffix flip and increment cur_flips.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Actually modifying suffix elements takes O(n^2) resulting in TLE.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a parity counter to track cumulative suffix flips without mutating the array.
